keyword: DN200 elbow versus printed trailer pipe diameter

title.en: Why the DN200 elbow is not the trailer pipe DN
title.zh: 为什么 DN200 弯管不是拖泵管径

description.en: The Xingtai elbow is labelled DN200 R275 90°. Published trailer and mixer pipe cells are 80 mm, 100–125 mm or 100 / 125 mm. The elbow page does not rewrite those cells.
description.zh: 邢台弯管铭牌是 DN200 R275 90°。已公布拖泵和搅拌泵的管径格是 80 mm、100–125 mm 或 100 / 125 mm。弯管页没有改写那些格子。

h1.en: DN200 elbow and the printed trailer pipe cells
h1.zh: DN200 弯管与已印拖泵管径

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery publishes one elbow size, DN200 R275 90°, and six pump pages with a smaller delivery-pipe cell. Buying the elbow does not set Electric 20, Electric 15, the Integrated Mixer Pump, HBT8018, HBT80-16 or LZ-60 to DN200.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械公布了一种弯管尺寸 DN200 R275 90°，另有六台泵的输送管格更小。购买这件弯管不会把电动20、电动15、搅拌泵一体机、HBT8018、HBT80-16 或 LZ-60 改成 DN200。

heading.zh: 目录里的两件不同物品

body.en: The elbow page prints DN200, R275, 90°, a pump-truck label and a heel bracket. The straight-pipe page prints a red pipe with coupling ends and no fixed DN. Diameter for a straight pipe is read from the pump sheet that actually has the cell.
body.zh: 弯管页印 DN200、R275、90°、泵车铭牌和弯头支架。直管页印的是带快接端的红管，没有固定公称直径。直管直径只读真正印了这一格的泵页。

heading.en: Published cells that stay as printed

body.en: Electric 20 remains 80 mm. Electric 15 remains 100–125 mm. Integrated Mixer Pump, HBT8018, HBT80-16 and LZ-60 remain 100 / 125 mm. Eighteen other pump pages have no pipe-diameter cell at all. None of those gaps is filled by DN200.
body.zh: 电动20仍是 80 mm。电动15仍是 100–125 mm。搅拌泵一体机、HBT8018、HBT80-16 和 LZ-60 仍是 100 / 125 mm。另外十八台泵根本没有管径格。这些空格不能用 DN200 填上。

heading.en: How to ask for the elbow

body.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Quote the elbow as DN200 R275 90°. Quote a straight pipe with the pump model and that model's own cell. Keep the two lines separate.
body.zh: 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 弯管按 DN200、R275、90° 询。直管按泵型号和该型号自己的格子询。两行分开写。

question.en: Can I order a DN125 elbow from this page?
question.zh: 能按这一页订 DN125 弯管吗？

answer.en: No DN125 elbow page exists. The published elbow is DN200 R275 90° only.
answer.zh: 没有 DN125 弯管页。已公布的弯管只有 DN200 R275 90°。

question.en: Does the pump-truck label create a boom-pump model?
question.zh: 泵车铭牌会生成臂架泵型号吗？

answer.en: No. There is no published truck-mounted boom pump page to link.
answer.zh: 不会。没有可链接的车载臂架泵页面。

question.en: Is life or wall thickness printed?

answer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, through the contact page.
answer.zh: 邢台河北品锦机械，通过联系页。

label.en: Email or WhatsApp the Xingtai factory
label.zh: 邮件或 WhatsApp 联系邢台工厂
